events.title: Next Fest Broadcast!
events.summary: Hey pilots!We're broadcasting Drone Arena right here on Steam for the whole of Next Fest. Drop by the store page anytime to watch some gameplay, see what the game is all about, and chat with us directly.Got questions about the game, feedback on the demo, or just want to say hi? We'll be reading the chat, so don't be shy.And if you like what you see, adding Drone Arena to your wishlist is the best way to support us. It really makes a difference for a small team like ours.See you in the arena!
